title: ColabFold: free protein folding with AlphaFold2 or RoseTTAFold
summary: ColabFold pairs AlphaFold2 or RoseTTAFold with fast MMseqs2 homology search and an extended sequence database, running free on Google Colab. The authors report it matches AlphaFold2 on CASP14 targets and matches AlphaFold-multimer on the ClusPro dataset. Caveat: the evidence is benchmark accuracy on established datasets, and this is a software tool paper rather than a new biological finding.
organization: Max Planck Institute for Multidisciplinary Sciences; Seoul National University
